partnershipPlan: A patient partner who stayed overnight unexpectedly and two booking nurses review the booking tool's wording and the plain-language summary.
socialListening: No social media listening; comments from the day surgery unit's feedback cards about overnight stays are themed.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: My son had taken the afternoon off to drive me home, and at seven they told me I was staying.
items.implication: Predict at booking so patients can plan.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Nobody at home that night; I would rather have known I was staying from the start.
items.implication: Report calibration for patients living alone.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: We write 'nauseous' or nothing; the antiemetic chart is what really tells you.
items.implication: Use and check the rescue antiemetic proxy.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: The last case of the day is the one that stays; we know that, and still book it there.
items.implication: Model list position and use the result in booking rules.

summary: Four composite voices on late conversion, living alone, nausea documentation and list order.
